description: Derived from AGSC-08-12: `ci` compiles the `codeowner` value of a gate's `enforce[]` into dist/forge/CODEOWNERS, and where a file the repository holds at the forge's own path differs from the compiled one, `ci` MUST report the difference as AGSC-E707, an error, and MUST NOT overwrite it. One L1 gate enforcing `codeowner` is added to the minimal fixture, with a .github/CODEOWNERS that names another owner than the fixture's operator. `ci --json` reports exactly one finding, AGSC-E707 naming .github/CODEOWNERS, and exits 1; the held file keeps its bytes; and the compiled file is written under dist/forge/. The bytes of the compiled CODEOWNERS are an implementation's choice (AGSC-08-12), so they are not asserted; nor is the compiled file compared with any earlier run.

add_files.content/gates/owners.md:
---
type: gate
title: Owners gate
description: A gate whose only enforcement is a code-owner file, held here for the forge case.
level: L1
enforce: [codeowner]
clusters:
  - agent-patterns
prov:
  origin: human
  operator: human:tester
---

Every change is reviewed by an owner.
